1.Nf3 Nf6 2.a4 g6 3.b4.strategy: Adds a second flank pawn advance before the centre or the pieces are looked after. It grabs queenside space and prepares a bishop on b2, but the pawns on a4 and b4 can only be defended by pieces, and the long diagonal stands open for Black's fianchettoed bishop until White's own bishop arrives.
1.Nf3 Nf6 2.a4 g6 3.b4.name: Zukertort Opening: Myers Polish Attack
